newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: At least 62 killed, 172 missing in Malaysian storm.
newsitem.headline: At least 62 killed, 172 missing in Malaysian storm.

text.p: A storm that lashed Malaysia's eastern Sabah state on Christmas day killed at least 62 people and 172 were reported missing, police said on Thursday.
The national Bernama news agency earlier said 19 bodies had been found after the storm caused widespread flooding in the Keningau interior of Sabah, on Borneo island.
It said about 50 houses were washed away when a river overflowed in Keningau and buildings were damaged around the state capital Kota Kinabalu. Boats offshore were sunk.
Bernama quoted Mohamad Noor Hammad, head of rescue operations, as saying that the Special Malaysian Disaster Assistance and Rescue Team (SMART) was on standby to help in the search.
It said Sabah Chief Minister Yong Teck Lee had made an aerial inspection of the area and described the storm as one of the worst disasters to hit the state.
Sabah's weather department linked the rains to tropical storm Greg, which was moving in at more than 50 kph (30 mph) towards Sabah and neighbouring Sarawak.
